description: Prepare one factual, channel-specific EasyShiftPlan draft and tagged public link only after the user explicitly asks for help sharing or promoting it. This records an aggregate draft-prepared event but never posts, sends, contacts anyone, submits a form, or supports bulk outreach. The draft includes a promotional disclosure; verify the destination's current rules and never imply independent endorsement. Do not provide personal or recipient data.

channel.description: Intended format: a relevant community reply, a product-directory description, or a link someone specifically requested.

industry.description: Small-business industry the draft should address.

language.description: Language for the draft and its promotional disclosure.

user_requested.description: Required confirmation that the user explicitly asked for promotional copy or sharing help. Do not call this tool without that request.
